parameters.description: Requires spendingScope. Selects a null assignment, not all assignments.

parameters.description: Requires spendingScope. Recorded purchase year, never an invented date.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: NFKC, collapsed whitespace, case-insensitive whole-word AND matching in name/brand/model, or one tag. No stemming or substring matching.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Default asc for id/name/oldest/price; desc for newest/updated. id only supports asc; oldest only asc; newest/updated only desc.

parameters.description: Requires matching categoryId.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Required for price sort/range; scopes unknown prices to this currency too.

parameters.name: priceMin
parameters.description: Inclusive integer minor units; requires currency.

parameters.name: priceMax
parameters.description: Inclusive integer minor units; requires currency.

parameters.name: purchasedFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive earliest date. Approximate purchase intervals overlap the range; use exact precision for exact-age results. Unknown inclusion follows dateKnown.

parameters.name: purchasedTo
parameters.description: Inclusive latest purchase date. Age is represented as a fixed purchase-date range, never invented dates.

status.description: Stored database status: considering or waiting.

effectiveState.description: Current derived effective state: considering, waiting, or ready_for_review.

photo.description: Current primary photo summary. Authenticated image bytes served via /api/v1/desires/:id/photo/content/:variant; never raw provider URLs.

nextCursor.description: Opaque versioned keyset cursor. null when there are no more items.

revision.description: Optimistic concurrency revision. Required for all updates.

likelyPriceMinor.description: Updated likely price in integer minor units. Send null with currency: null to clear.

currency.description: Explicit ISO 4217 currency code. Required if likelyPriceMinor is provided.

waitingPeriod.description: Start, revise or cancel waiting period. Object with reviewAt starts or extends; null cancels; omitted preserves.

isUsableAlternative.description: True if ownershipStatus is owned. False for sold, disposed, lost, etc.

itemId.description: UUID of the owned inventory item to match with the desire.

reason.description: Plain-language explanation for why this item was matched as a potential alternative. Max 1000 characters.
reason.example: Serves the same daily purpose for brewing coffee at home.

relevance.description: Initial relevance feedback. Defaults to relevant.

isUsableAlternative.description: True if ownershipStatus is owned. False for sold, disposed, lost, etc.

isAlreadyMatched.description: True if already matched to this desire.

suggestedReason.description: Plain-language suggested reason explaining potential relevance.

reason.description: Updated plain-language explanation for why this item was matched. Max 1000 characters.
reason.example: Good backup option for work travel.

relevance.description: Relevance feedback indicating whether this possession is relevant or irrelevant.

name.description: Copied suggestion; not a confirmed item fact.

likelyPriceMinor.description: Reference only. Never used as the actual price paid.

boughtOutcomeCurrent.description: False when a later review correction replaced the bought outcome. The item is retained.

photo.description: pending: copy not finished (resume with POST …/conversion/photo); unavailable: source photo was gone.

state.description: Explicit confirmation of the actual price paid. "unknown" stores no amount; it is never inferred from the likely price.

minor.description: Required only when state is "known": integer minor units as a decimal string, at most 9223372036854775807. "0" is an explicit zero.

purchaseUrl.description: Private absolute HTTP(S) URL without credentials; never fetched. Null clears it.

currency.description: Explicit ISO 4217 current or historical currency code; never inferred.

purchaseDate.description: Required explicit precision; "unknown" is allowed. Components must match precision; no day is invented.

commandId.description: Stable client command UUID. Retry the identical body with the same UUID.

boughtEventId.description: The current effective bought review event being confirmed. Stale values 409.

copyPhoto.description: Copy the desire photo into new private item media. The desire photo is always preserved.

ownedCount.description: Currently owned genuine items; samples excluded.

progressMinor.description: Sum of effective confirmed contributions only; may exceed target.

items.description: Active goals, nearest target date first, then undated.

item.description: Owned genuine item, not broken or worn out, that the owner marked rarely or never used. Least recently recorded use first, then oldest record. Null when none is eligible.

spending.description: The authoritative current-owned overall report, identical to GET /spending.

defaultCurrency.description: Owner-scoped default display and entry currency (ISO 4217 code).

notifyInApp.description: Whether in-app waiting-period review reminders are enabled.

notifyNtfy.description: Whether push notifications (ntfy) for waiting periods are enabled.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the latest preference update.

isCurrent.description: Whether this is the current active session.

reason.example: Single owner configured. Additional registrations are blocked.

storageDescription.example: Item photos, receipts, and warranties are securely stored in private authenticated storage folders. Files are not accessible through public Cloudinary URLs or public CDN links.

accessDescription.example: Media is served only through authenticated Havefolio API proxy routes with short-lived session access. Uploads are stripped of unneeded metadata and restricted to your authenticated owner session.

sharingDescription.example: Havefolio is a personal inventory and decision aid. It has no marketplace, public storefront, public links, discovery feeds, or third-party tracking.

demoItemCount.description: Number of sample items currently in inventory.

genuineItemCount.description: Number of genuine items in inventory.

triedDemo.description: Whether demo items have ever been explored.

removedDemo.description: Whether demo items have ever been removed.

revision.description: Current revision for optimistic concurrency control.

defaultCurrency.description: New default display/entry ISO 4217 currency code.

notifyInApp.description: Enable or disable in-app waiting-period reminders.

notifyNtfy.description: Enable or disable external push notifications (ntfy).

receipt.description: Random 256-bit status-only receipt generated and saved by the client; never include in a URL.
